title: Rigged and animated Cat — mesh-only FBX conversion
author: JonasDichelle (original); Antti Nuortimo (FBX conversion)
inspection: 22650 vertices; one continuous natural quadruped cat mesh; no armature, no actions, no texture images in the public FBX. Includes three material slots. Original complete Blender file on BlendSwap requires sign-in. Candidate suitable as a rigging base, not finished product art.
credit: Cat base mesh adapted from Rigged and animated Cat by JonasDichelle, CC BY 3.0, https://blendswap.com/blend/18519. FBX conversion by Antti Nuortimo (Ylikuutio). Changes: new quadruped rig, skinning, 12 baked actions, face geometry, breed morphs, 16 procedural coats and skinned fur tufts. See public/assets/cats/3d/ATTRIBUTION.txt.
